name: Dilan 1982 Timor Timur
overview: Upon his return to Bandung, Dilan brings back a million memories of East Timor—from learning tolerance with his best friend, Lopez, to witnessing Bunda's resilience amidst the shadow of conflict. His childhood there was filled with adventures, from the mystery of screams in a silent valley to the diplomatic ball game to settle a dispute with a kid from the neighboring village.
